summary: pr-link.yml holds contents:write, the only write surface. It is fork-guarded (if github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository) so a fork PR cannot trigger the write, and it commits ONLY to the PR branch, never main. Ticket resolution intersects with real roadmap keys (candidates &= story_keys), so a crafted PR body cannot inject an arbitrary key. The Gate A / board checks are read-only and deterministic (contents:read).

non_blocking_findings.summary: contents:write on a pull_request workflow is a trust surface; mitigated by the same-repo fork guard and by writing only to the PR branch. A maintainer should confirm branch protection permits the forge-pr-link[bot] branch push, and that the 'edited' trigger (loop-guarded) is acceptable.

residual_risks: The write token is scoped to the workflow run; the loop guard prevents re-trigger storms on body edits.
